title: The {key:z} Family
subtitle: Folding, scrolling, spell. The most thematically scattered prefix.
summary: {key:z} contains three historical clusters: scroll positioning ({key:z}{key:z}, {key:z}{key:t}, {key:z}{key:b}), folding ({key:z}{key:o}, {key:z}{key:c}, {key:z}{key:f}, {key:z}{key:R}), and spelling ({key:z}{key:=}, {key:z}{key:g}, {key:z}{key:w}).

blocks.text: The {key:z} prefix does not have one meaning. Three separate clusters share the namespace: scrolling, folding, and spelling. Learn the pattern inside each cluster, but do not expect a new {key:z} command to be predictable from the prefix alone.

blocks.title: The Three Sub-Families
blocks.text:
**Scrolling** — {key:z}{key:z}, {key:z}{key:t}, {key:z}{key:b}, {key:z}{key:.}, {key:z}{key:+}, {key:z}{key:-}, {key:z}{key:s}, {key:z}{key:e}, {key:z}{key:h}, {key:z}{key:l}, {key:z}{key:H}, {key:z}{key:L}, {key:z}{n}{key:Enter}. Cover the viewport — see [*Centering the Cursor*](#scroll.center-top-bottom) and [*Horizontal Scroll*](#scroll.horizontal).

**Folding** — {key:z}{key:o}/{key:z}{key:c} (open/close fold), {key:z}{key:O}/{key:z}{key:C} (recursive), {key:z}{key:R}/{key:z}{key:M} (reduce/more — open/close all), {key:z}{key:r}/{key:z}{key:m} (one level), {key:z}{key:a} (toggle), {key:z}{key:f}{motion} (create), {key:z}{key:d} (delete), {key:z}{key:E} (eliminate all). Cover folding — see [*Folding*](#advanced.folding).

**Spell** — {key:z}{key:=} (suggestions for misspelled word under cursor), {key:z}{key:g} (mark word as correct), {key:z}{key:w} (mark as wrong), {key:z}{key:u}{key:g}/{key:z}{key:u}{key:w} (undo each).

blocks.title: Why {key:z} Has No Single Theme
blocks.text: The scrolling commands change the window's viewport. The folding commands manage hidden regions and fold definitions. The spelling commands inspect or update spelling information. Calling all three a single "view layer" suggests a consistency that Vim does not provide. The useful structure begins after the prefix: {key:z}{key:z}/{key:z}{key:t}/{key:z}{key:b} position the current line, {key:z}{key:o}/{key:z}{key:c} open and close folds, and {key:z}{key:g}/{key:z}{key:w} mark words as good or wrong.
